cause: ViewThatFits and the warning content negotiated their ideal width with an aspectRatio modifier in a height-constrained stack. The warning was allowed to influence the video canvas dimensions; an expanding outer frame did not constrain its candidate measurements.
fix: Give the warning the actual video proposal through GeometryReader, constrain both fitting candidates to the available width, and center them in the inset canvas. Use a 16:9 Color canvas with the warning as an overlay in the production theatre and matching fixture; preview already has explicit video width/height.
regression: Keep 16:9, contained message/actions, compact gap, centered group, larger controls and hittability assertions. Add full expected canvas width (360-point preview, full-width portrait theatre) so even a smaller 16:9 box cannot pass. Existing preferences, media-start, real-video clipping and buffering-footer checks remain required.
